title: Book 4 — Melpomene, Chapter 186
paragraphs: I have said that from Egypt as far as Lake Tritonis there dwell Libyans who are nomads, eating flesh and drinking milk. These do not at all taste of the flesh of cows, for the same reason the Egyptians too abstain from it, nor do they keep swine. Moreover the women of the Cyrenaeans also think it wrong to eat cows' flesh, because of the Egyptian Isis, and they even keep fasts and celebrate festivals in her honor; and the women of Barca, in addition to not eating cow's flesh, also do not taste swine.
